args.title: Fix weekly export to send the first scheduled email immediately
args.body:
File: src/export/scheduler.ts

The issue with the weekly scheduled export not sending the first email immediately after setup has been identified. We will ensure that when a weekly export is scheduled, it triggers the first email without delay, thus providing immediate confirmation of the scheduled export setup.
